OTP login: POST /api/auth/login → use dev_otp + session_token → POST /api/auth/verify-otp with {email, session_token, code}. Token must be set in localStorage under sawali_token, token, access_token. The 'Enregistrer les paramètres' button at the bottom of /admin/settings persists ALL state including the new qdrant_image_auto_describe toggle. Briefing modal 'J'ai lu' must be dismissed on first load of authenticated pages.
